<module id="calendar">
    <description>Perpetual calendar module with 6-bit outputs for hours, minutes, and seconds.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="RST">Active-high reset signal.</input>
        <output id="Hours" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current hours.</output>
        <output id="Mins" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current minutes.</output>
        <output id="Secs" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current seconds.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        reg [5:0] Secs;
        reg [5:0] Mins;
        reg [5:0] Hours;

        always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                Secs <= 6'd0;
                Mins <= 6'd0;
                Hours <= 6'd0;
            end else begin
                if (Secs == 6'd59) begin
                    Secs <= 6'd0;
                    if (Mins == 6'd59) begin
                        Mins <= 6'd0;
                        if (Hours == 6'd23) begin
                            Hours <= 6'd0;
                        end else begin
                            Hours <= Hours + 1;
                        end
                    end else begin
                        Mins <= Mins + 1;
                    end
                end else begin
                    Secs <= Secs + 1;
                end
            end
        end

        assign Hours = Hours;
        assign Mins = Mins;
        assign Secs = Secs;
    </implementation>
</module>
